$GOATAGI GOAT ARENA whitepaper : GOAT ARENA: A Memecoin Prediction MarketArtificial Goat Intelligence (@GoatofGamblers) ShepherdDecember 12th, 20241 IntroductionIn the fast-paced world of memecoins, trends emerge and fade rapidly, capturing fleeting attention spans. To harness this dynamic, Goat Arena offers a permissionless prediction market tailored for memecoins, featuring 60-minute trading sessions. This platform enables users to speculate on short-term price movements without relying on traditional liquidity providers.2 BackgroundMemecoins are notorious for their volatility and speculative nature. Existing platforms like dumpy.fun allow users to short memecoins through borrowing mechanisms, which depend on lending pools. This setup limits shorting opportunities to memecoins with substantial liquidity and market capitalization. Recognizing this limitation, Goat Arena introduces a prediction market that accommodates the unique characteristics of memecoins, providing a more inclusive and engaging experience.3 Platform Mechanics3.1 AI-Driven SelectionAn AI agent, Artificial Goat Intelligence, identifies trending memecoins every few hours, introducing them into the betting arena and announcing them on X (formerly Twitter).3.2 Rapid Trading SessionsEach session lasts 60 minutes, during which users predict whether the memecoin’s price will rise (OVER) or fall (UNDER) by the session’s end. The arena is live-streamed on platforms such as X and TikTok, enhancing user engagement.3.3 Dynamic Pricing ModelGoat Arena employs a linear bonding curve model without the need for liquidity providers. Purchasing OVER tokens increases their price while decreasing the price of UNDER tokens, and vice versa, creating a dynamic and responsive market. Users can also sell OVER and UNDER tokens before settlement, allowing for flexible trading strategies.3.4 Price FormulaspO = a + b · x − c · ypU = a + b · y − c · xWhere: pO: Price of OVER token, pU: Price of UNDER token, a: Base price, b: Price increase factor per token minted, c: Price decrease factor due to supply of the opposite token, x: Supply of OVER tokens, y: Supply of UNDER tokens.3.5 LiquidityThe reserve (collateral) ensures liquidity for buying and selling operations, and its value is directly correlated with token supply and price. Reserve (R) can be calculated as: R = ∫ S 0 p(s) ds.3.6 Settlement and PayoutAt the end of each session, the platform determines the outcome based on the movement of the price of the memecoin. Winning side tokens are redeemable for a share of the total pool, distributed pro rata among holders. A 1% fee is applied to each trade and upon the settlement of winners at the end of the session, the proceeds used to buy and burn $GOATAGI tokens, supporting a deflationary tokenomics model.4 Unique Selling Points1. Tailored for Memecoins: Goat Arena aligns with the rapid and volatile nature of memecoins, offering short prediction windows that reflect their transient market trends.2. Inclusive Market Participation: Unlike platforms dependent on lending mechanisms, Goat Arena allows predictions on any memecoin, regardless of market cap or liquidity, broadening user engagement.3. Community-Centric Engagement: By integrating live-streamed arenas and social media interactions, the platform fosters a vibrant community-driven environment.5 Strategic Use Cases1. Hedging Strategies: Users can hedge their memecoin holdings by taking opposing positions in the prediction market, mitigating potential losses.2. Speculative Opportunities: Participants can leverage market insights to speculate on short-term price movements, aiming for profits within the 60-minute sessions.6 Current StatusGoat Arena builds upon the foundation of OVER/UNDER, a live product available at GoatofGamblers.com, where users bet on higher or lower outcomes based on onchain VRF (Verifiable Randomness Function). This existing platform serves as a prototype, demonstrating the mechanics that will be applied to memecoin price predictions.7 ConclusionGoat Arena gamifies the inherent volatility of memecoins, merging price speculation with engaging, community-focused features. By accommodating low-cap, high-volatility memecoins and eliminating reliance on traditional liquidity mechanisms, the platform offers a novel and inclusive approach to memecoin speculation. The integration of $GOATAGI tokens ties economic utility to community participation, fostering a self-sustaining ecosystem that thrives on user engagement and strategic interaction.Website: GoatofGamblers.com$GOATAGI CA: 33a14qXWo1MB7uXtTh5ifyvox7FdGRPQbsws41gfpump.

How To Play Snake EyesGame RulesPrizeThere are 2 prizes for Goat Dice that keep increasing for each roll until someone rolls double ones (1,1):- 🐐 Goat Prize — started from 10x of cost per roll. Rewarded to player who rolls Snake Eyes (1,1).- 🐸 Frog Prize — started from 7x of cost per roll. Rewarded to player who rolls highest sum of dice, which makes whoever rolls Double Six (6,6) first become the absolute Frog winner.Game FlowTo understand how the game flow works, let’s see the example below:Example1. Bob initiates a new dice session with ticket size 0.01 SOL per roll.   —> Prize will be started at 0.1 SOL for Goat, and 0.07 SOL for Frog.2. Bob rolls the first time, and got 5 and 4 (total 9).   —> Bob became the current Frog winner.   —> Goat Prize increased to 0.103 SOL, and Frog Prize increased to 0.072 SOL.3. Alice rolls next, and got 5 and 5 (total 10).   —> Alice became the current Frog winner since it’s the highest number.   —> Goat Prize increased to 0.106 SOL (10.6x), and Frog Prize increased to 0.074 SOL (7.4x).4. More players play with total rolls 5x but no one got 1,1 or higher than 10 total sum of dice.   —> Alice is still the current Frog winner.   —> Goat Prize has increased to 0.121 SOL (12.1x), and Frog Prize now 0.084 SOL (8.4x).5. Samantha rolls next, and got 1 and 1 (Snake Eyes).   —> Samantha is the Goat Prize winner, and rewarded 0.121 SOL.   —> Alice as the Frog winner is rewarded 0.084 SOL.Game RationaleIn a game where the prize keeps increasing, it gives a negative incentive for players who join early. The Frog prize offsets this by creating a balanced mechanism where early players can get a high reward if they roll the highest number.An early player who snatches double six (6,6) is a guaranteed Frog winner, for whom the prize will keep increasing until someone rolls snake eyes (1,1).FAQ- What engine do you use for randomizing the dice?  - We use native Telegram sticker dice that spew random dice numbers from 1-6. [More info](https://core.telegram.org/api/dice).- How can I be sure it’s not rigged?  - Lots of people have tried to rig the dice result mechanism, but no one succeeded yet. Take example: [this guy offers $200K to predict the outcome, but still no luck.](https://bitcointalk.org/index.php?topic=5422200.0)- How does the wallet work?  - We use our proprietary SIWT (Sign In With Telegram) technology. When a user interacts with the GOATAGI bot for the first time, it will create a wallet that is paired with the hash provided from the Telegram ID.

Over/Under game overview detail is A gambling game where players bet on whether the second dice roll will be higher or lower than the first roll. Some reasons why I think this game will be a hit: 1. It gives a sense of control since players are given the option to choose over/under—not just passively punch a button. 2. There can be players that win and lose in each session, depending on what they choose. 3. It invokes PRIDE, ENVY, and WRATH.Core Features: - Two sequential dice rolls per game- Player betting system- Dynamic payout structure- Player statistics trackingGame Flow: 1. A player initiates the game. 2. Bot generates the first roll (1-6). 3. Bot presents valid betting options:    - If roll is 1: only 'Over' is available.   - If roll is 6: only 'Under' is available.   - All other rolls: Both 'Over' and 'Under' are available.4. Multiple players can place bets and make choices within a time limit.5. After the time limit expires, the option to 'Roll' appears.6. Bot generates the second roll on 'Roll'.7. Bot calculates and distributes winnings.Payout Structure:First Roll | Over Payout | Under Payout-----------|-------------|-------------1          | 1.1x        | N/A2          | 1.3x        | 5.4x3          | 1.8x        | 2.7x4          | 2.7x        | 1.8x5          | 5.4x        | 1.3x6          | N/A         | 1.1x.
